meta.coverage_note: The scored destination sample is restricted to schools in the top 50 of at least one source ranking, including ties. PhD origins are unrestricted. Reviewed faculty outside the scored sample are shown without placement credit. Top-3 destination weights are unadjusted whole article counts divided by the publication-window length, averaged across available ASU/UTD sources. ASU covers 2016–2025 and UTD covers 2017–2026 (partial 2026), both JF/JFE/RFS. There is no faculty-size or reference-school scaling and no further research-rank cutoff. Alternative scores use each source’s top 100, including ties, and normalize to Wharton; the UTD alternative uses its Score column, while Top-3s/year uses its Articles column. Missing research counts give zero Top-3 credit without excluding alternative scores. Program scores sum graduate contributions with self placements capped at one-quarter of the Top-3 total; alternative scores inherit that proportional adjustment. Across displayed records, 3473 complete PhD records are supplied as verified among 4691 submitted faculty. Source and verification labels reflect supplied evidence; career histories and primary/tenure status may be incomplete.
